title: Arrays & Hashing

views.title: Arrays & Hashing
views.intro: The core move is turning a nested loop into one pass plus a map: store what you have seen (value, prefix sum, balance) and look up what you need. Most "count subarrays" problems are prefix sum + frequency map.
table: Subarray sum = k, divisible by k, balanced 0/1
Dutch flag, rotate, next permutation, matrices

files.desc: Two sum, subarray sums, product except self, anagram groups, longest consecutive, top K, cyclic sort, Boyer-Moore, Dutch flag, next permutation, rotations, matrix ops, trapping water

pitfalls: Prefix-sum maps must be seeded with {0: 1} (or {0: -1} for earliest index).
Negative mod: normalize with ((x % k) + k) % k.
Longest consecutive: only start counting at sequence heads to stay O(n).

decisions.q: Count contiguous subarrays with a sum condition (negatives allowed)?

decisions.a: Map 0 to -1, first-seen index of each balance
Cyclic sort or Floyd on i to a[i]

calibration: SDE2 bar: two sum, group anagrams, product except self, longest consecutive, subarray sum equals k, merge sorted arrays.
SDE3 bar: first missing positive in O(1) space, next permutation, matrix rotations, trapping rain water, reservoir sampling and shuffle correctness.
Staff bar (for context): proving in-place algorithms correct, streaming variants (reservoir sampling, approximate counts), and choosing between sorting and hashing by memory limits.
